messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Tomasz Nowak wrote the billing-api handover doc for Marcus on 2025-03-17. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
- There is a deploy freeze on the billing service from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 because of peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-04]
- As of 2025-09-08, billing-api has a new dependency on the feature-flags service. [valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- Billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind the feature-flags service because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. [decision; valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- The billing service depends on the ledger for invoice postings. [valid 2025-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-10]
- There is a deploy freeze on the ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-19]
- As of 2026-05-26, the billing service is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Boreal. [valid 2026-05-26 to now; recorded by handover/2026-05-26-billing-api]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-17, the billing service lives with Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-17 to 2026-05-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- Lena is the release captain for Q1 2026. [valid 2025-06-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-06-05-2]
- On 2026-03-31, the Ember team observed that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and flagged it because the service is not theirs. [valid 2026-03-31 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-31]
- Oskar is the only engineer on the Ember team for now. [valid 2025-01-10 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-10]
- As of 2026-05-25, Team Atlas has switched to a no-deploy Friday. [decision; valid 2026-05-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-25-2]
- Oskar is on call for the Ember team to start the year. [valid 2025-01-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-14]
- The catalog service relies on the resizer for thumbnails, so if the resizer is down, the catalog service is down. [valid 2025-04-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-15]
- The nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
- As of 2025-10-22, Farah is Team Dune's release captain for Q3 2025. [valid 2025-10-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-22-2]
- The ledger relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-17]
- On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder reported that the ledger's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-07-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-28-2]
- On 2026-02-12, the Ember team reported that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2026-02-12 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-02-12]
- On 2026-03-10, Team Dune observed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
- As of 2025-10-27, Yuki is the primary on-call for Team Cinder, having taken over from Diego. [valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-27]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, Diego is the primary on-call for Team Cinder, having taken over from Yuki. [valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-10-27; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-29]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-10, Yuki is the primary on-call for Team Cinder until the next rotation. [valid 2025-07-10 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-10]
    earlier: As of 2025-05-19, Diego is the primary on-call for Team Cinder. [valid 2025-05-19 to 2025-07-10; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-19]
    earlier: As of 2025-04-09, Yuki is the primary on-call for Team Cinder. [valid 2025-04-09 to 2025-05-19; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-09]

Question: What is the deploy window for billing-api?
